source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with layered rocky cliffs, misty ravine spaces, pines and leafless trees, small retreats, a lower waterside village, and narrow stream gorges. Calligraphy, seals, border wear, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: upper_left_sheer_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the pale vertical cliff mass in the upper left: a broad flat-topped rock wall with irregular ink outline, soft tan wash, faint vertical striations, and sparse brushy shrubs along the rim and right shoulder. Exclude nearby red seals and calligraphy.
must_preserve: small dark shrub strokes on the upper rim
soft mist-like blank space around the lower cliff edge

motifs.name: upper_right_bushy_crags
motifs.description: Isolate the high right mountain formation with overlapping rounded crags, diagonal ravines, and dense twig-like vegetation clinging to ledges and gullies.

motifs.name: central_misty_waterfall_chasm
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow central vertical chasm between cliffs, including the pale blank waterfall or mist column, darkened cliff edges, and the small ledge vegetation at the top.
must_preserve: dark ink edge accents on both cliff sides
subtle wash transitions into surrounding rock
small brushy plants on the upper lip

motifs.name: wind_bent_dead_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the dramatic wind-bent old pine and dead trunk on the left middle slope: tall twisted trunk, bare angular branches, hanging pine boughs, and a horizontal needled branch projecting right.
must_preserve: gnarled trunk contour with reddish-brown wash
bent hanging limb at lower left

motifs.name: central_pine_grove_on_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the central stand of tall pines and mixed trees growing across the middle slope, with layered umbrella-like pine crowns, slender trunks, and interlaced bare branches.
must_preserve: branch networks drawn in fine ink
tall vertical trunks with darker bases
rocky slope wash visible between trunks

motifs.name: mid_right_retreat_in_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the small retreat pavilion or hut in the mid-lower right, set among leafless vertical trees on a pale clearing against the hillside.
must_preserve: thin vertical tree trunks surrounding the building
pale clearing edge and adjacent rock wash

motifs.name: lower_lakeside_village_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the lower waterside village cluster: connected roofed buildings and pavilion platforms beside water, railings, triangular gables, a willow-like tree, and tiny seated figures.
must_preserve: angled roof planes and gable linework
willow and shrub brushwork around the buildings
flat grey-green water shape beside the architecture

motifs.name: lower_central_rocky_stream_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central ravine and stream corridor leading upward through angular rocks, including pale water channels, faceted boulders, and soft ocher cliff washes.
must_preserve: layered ocher and grey wash texture
misty pale gaps between rock faces

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
